history.content: ok i dont even know why im opening this but i need to vent before i throw my phone. been dealing with this stupid health thing for MONTHS now and i just got off the phone with the specialist office again
That sounds exhausting, especially after months of it, and then being back on the phone with the specialist office again. I’m here to listen, if you want to keep venting.

no its not just exhausting its making me FURIOUS. like im not overwhelmed im pissed. they cancelled my appointment AGAIN. third time. ive been waiting since february to find out what this thing in my chest is and every time im finally close they just bump me to next month like im nothing
You’re furious, and the third cancellation after waiting since February feels like being pushed aside again and again. If you want, you can keep going with it or we can just leave it there for now.

yeah keep going. and the thing is i CANT even be properly angry at anyone because the receptionist is just a person doing her job and the doctor is overbooked and its the system right its always the system. so i just sit here being polite on the phone saying oh ok thats fine i understand when its NOT fine. nothing about this is fine
You’re having to stay polite while everything in you says it is not fine, and that clash sounds intense. I’m curious whether the anger is more hot and ready to push back, or more tight and trapped.

trapped. definitely trapped. like theres all this heat with nowhere to go. i lie awake at night googling symptoms which i KNOW i shouldnt do and then i get up and ive got work and i cant tell anyone because what do i even say, hey i might have something serious but also i dont know anything because nobody will TELL me. its the not knowing thats eating me. 4 months of not knowing
That sounds like anger holding a lot of fear underneath it, and the worst part is the not knowing. If you want, we can stay with that trapped feeling, or leave it here for now.

ok yeah. the fear thing. i didnt want to say it but yeah. its easier to be angry than scared honestly. when im angry at the hospital at least i feel like im DOING something even if im not. the scared version of me just feels like a little kid who wants someone to hold their hand and tell them its gonna be ok and nobody can do that right now. so i pick angry. angry feels stronger
Anger feels like the stronger one, and the scared part sounds younger, like it wants a hand to hold. We can stay with that, or leave it here if that’s enough for now.

i think i can stay a minute more. its weird saying all this out loud even just typing it. the angry part isnt gonna go away because honestly they DESERVE some anger, four cancellations is genuinely not ok, im allowed to be mad about that. but i guess i dont have to pretend the scared part isnt there too. both can be true. the mad one is kind of protecting the scared one from having to just sit there alone
That makes a lot of sense, the mad part is guarding the scared one so it doesn’t have to sit there alone. I can stay with that, or we can leave it right there.

yeah i think i can actually leave it there now. i feel a bit less like im gonna explode. the appointment is rebooked for the 28th and i cant do anything til then so. ill just have to carry both of em around til i know more i guess. thanks for letting me dump all that, i really needed somewhere to put it
Of course, and I’m glad you had somewhere to put it. Carrying both of them until the 28th sounds like a lot, and you don’t have to keep it all packed away alone tonight.
thanks. that means more than you know. ok im gonna try to sleep without googling anything for once lol. night
Night. I’m glad it got a little quieter for tonight.
